agent_priors_used: Prior: Long-horizon agents accumulate path dependence/salience bias and local optima — inherited mechanisms without freshness/UNKNOWN abstention compound errors; motivates prioritizing freshness guards and calibrated abstention (ECE) over pure accuracy, distinguished from SPIDER evidence which only shows narrow mock orthogonality r~0.04.

Prior: Exact trajectory replay beats semantic retrieval on narrow benchmarks but collapses under shift — strong baselines (nearest successful trajectory, RAG, instruction, 0-token replay) required to claim inheritance; SPIDER's 5.42% synthetic saving and 0.19-bit TodoMVC PMI not yet vs strong retrieval, so real LLM vs cold/retrieval/SPIDER is prioritized.

Prior: Tool-use agents fail via looping/error cascades detectable from step telemetry without LLM judge and are repairable by rollback to last fact-gathering step — supports prioritizing deterministic verification + localized delta-repair over LLM-as-judge, and justifies graph delta-repair with real verify() vs cold re-exploration.

Prior: Exploration/exploitation and incremental computation — most Web mutations are local DOM/param/header changes; full re-exploration is wasteful if mechanisms encode parameter slots and applicability guards — motivates delta-repair <50% tokens test as direct test of work compression beyond synthetic novelty mocks.

allocation.comparative_reasoning: Continuing TV divergence (PCA, per-type bias correction at n=500/1000) or incremental program-synthesis delta-repair duplicates graph's bounded-cost test and physics PMI; semantic resolution offers higher upside outside current basin and aligns with frontier charter to search orthogonal levels. It also complements product param-inherit by testing alias generalization with abstention rather than pure parameter binding.

allocation.question: Does a genuine (non-oracle) state-conditioned reconstruction adapter that critiques/reconstructs the retrieved template via structural analysis of (intent, observation-derived state, retrieved_template) — without access to ground-truth alias_family/query_key/target_prefix signals and without hardcoded confidence — achieve alias-OOD correct_resolution >=0.50 (binomial p<0.05 vs 0.10, McNemar p<0.05 vs exact matcher) and false_accept <=0.15 (>=0.15 below verbatim, p<0.05) while preserving exact-match >=0.90 and no-applicable UNKNOWN precision >=0.85 with ECE <=0.15, tested on the same three alias families (query-param, path-rewriting, server-routing) plus held-out variations and a limited live-browser WebShop/ALFWorld proxy where available?
allocation.rationale: Frontier tunnel 8/10 W-DYNAMICS (13/15) on synthetic 10D TV/KDE/kNN variants shows translation-only ceiling, complementary blind spots, and synthetic-to-real gap; previous semantic-resolve attempt was MEASUREMENT_INVALID due to oracle signals and hardcoded confidence, leaving calibrated applicability (UNKNOWN precision, ECE) untested. Genuine non-oracle reconstruction is orthogonal to TV divergence basin, directly tests SPIDER's semantic applicability and stale-intent false_accept risk flagged by agent prior, with falsifiable calibration gates. Success would change architecture (retrieval+ reconstruction vs exact matcher); failure cleanly parks semantic claim.

director_mandate.portfolio_assessment: SPIDER at 230 exps has a narrow validated core (C-MEAS-VALID header-only discrimination on localhost, C-FRESHNESS orthogonality r~0.04 on mock/single-node, Bayesian null control on synthetic SPA) but product-critical central promise remains untested: no end-to-end real LLM inheritance vs strong baselines, no delta-repair cost vs cold, no parameterized transfer on unseen identifiers with real execution. 38/230 MEASUREMENT_INVALID shows substrate validity remains bottleneck. C-PRODUCT-ECON model extrapolation is definitively closed (6 failures, logistic = constant null) leaving Docker/full-DOM as only path. Two tunnel flags (graph 9/10 FRESHNESS, frontier 13/15 W-DYNAMICS TV variants translation-only) consume capacity on marginal mock variants with diminishing info gain. Highest marginal value is to (a) unblock distributed freshness substrate (runtime shared session), (b) convert verified byte-preserving nginx HIT cache into first real delta-repair bounded-cost test (graph), (c) reactivate idle product on starved C-PARAM-INHERIT with real LLM vs cold/retrieval/SPIDER, (d) force frontier out of TV basin into calibrated semantic resolution, (e) pivot physics from hash-SPA PMI to BrowserState beyond-memory on branching/production SPAs, (f) fix intel AX/Mind2Web validity prerequisite for all holdout designs. Depth on localhost mocks is exhausted; breadth on real LLM+Playwright+verification is next leverage point.

Adopted its substrate-unblock recommendations (runtime distributed session fix, graph delta-repair on verified HIT/SWR/SIE/304, frontier exit from TV basin) and its candidate questions for frontier semantic adapter and physics BrowserState. Challenged/redirected its suggestions where local handoff was stale: superseded graph FRESHNESS micro-variants, runtime body-only isolation, physics Mind2Web-recovery handoff (intel job), and product synthetic residual-novelty mock (replaced with real LLM param-inherit). Prioritized intel AX/Mind2Web validity fix before Docker full-DOM because holdout measurement invalidity blocks product/graph more than extrapolation modeling.
